$comment: Every data-* attribute the library emits, classified against ADR 002 R4. R4 was drawn from the same menu-and-overlay sample R2 was; this is the catalogue that amends it against what actually ships. Counts are emission sites in src/components.

data-error.precedent: Ark Field / Radix Form emit data-invalid

data-open.precedent: Radix emits data-state="open|closed" on every disclosure

data-today.precedent: Ark DatePicker emits data-today on the current day

data-clickable.precedent: NOVEL - no peer ships it. Not the inverse of data-disabled: a Stepper step ahead of the current one is non-clickable without being disabled.

data-dragging.precedent: Ark Slider emits data-dragging on the thumb

data-placeholder.precedent: Radix Select emits data-placeholder on an unset trigger

data-sorted.precedent: NOVEL - column sort direction; no peer ships a data grid

data-resizing.precedent: NOVEL - active resize drag; sibling of data-dragging

data-filled.precedent: NOVEL - an OTP slot holding a character

data-success.reason: R4 has data-invalid but no positive counterpart, and no peer ships one. Renaming it data-valid would mint a term nothing else uses. Amendment B puts error|success on the MESSAGE part's data-state; this attribute stays on the field root, where it says something data-invalid cannot.

data-status.reason: Stepper's own enum (completed|active|pending|error). data-state now carries the library-wide value alongside it, but data-status keeps `error` and `pending`, which data-state's vocabulary cannot express in one slot.

data-direction.reason: Writing direction (ltr|rtl), not a state. Distinct from data-orientation.

data-next-status.reason: Stepper connector's lookahead; describes the NEXT step, so no single-element state attribute fits.

data-range-start / -end / -in-range.reason: Superseded by the tri-value data-range added in Amendment D. Kept until Task 3 retires them alongside the keys they mirror; removing them now would break consumers before the replacement is documented.

notState.$comment: Identity, configuration and test hooks. Outside R4's scope; no convergence owed.
